strengths: Andaman & Nicobar Command (India's only tri-service unified military command) sits astride the northern approach to the Strait of Malacca — the Andaman Islands are within a few hundred kilometres of the strait's entrance, giving the Indian Navy a real position from which to monitor or, in a severe crisis, complicate Chinese shipping through the chokepoint China itself calls its 'Malacca Dilemma'
